newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FORGOTTEN RHODES NUDGES SELECTORS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FORGOTTEN RHODES NUDGES SELECTORS.

text.p: Forgotten South African batsman Jonty Rhodes gave the national selectors a timely nudge with a career-best 156 not out for Natal on Sunday in the latest round of Supersport Series matches.
Rhodes, out of favour since playing against India in Ahmedabad last November, batted for just under six hours as Natal reached 349 for seven declared in their second innings.
Set 472 to win Free State were 68 without loss at the close of the third day.
Rhodes struck 15 fours and three sixes in a chanceless innings which spanned 285 balls.
"I'm feeling a lot more relaxed with my batting now but I haven't set my sights on getting back into the South African team -- if I did, I could get disappointed," Rhodes said.
"Obviously it's my goal to play for South Africa again but it's also my goal to enjoy myself -- and today I enjoyed myself."
In the other match being played in Port Elizabeth, Western Province had reached 165 for two in their second innings with another test reject Jacques Kallis 71 not out.
Western Province have an overall lead of 266 after Eastern Province declared their first innings on 300 for nine, Louis Koen making 128.
